notes: Pools were labelled A/Orange, B/Green, C/Blue, D/Red.

Pool scores come from the whiteboard, whose SCORE columns are each team's points in rounds 1-5; games were rebuilt by pairing them with the poster's round-robin schedule. All 18 W-L-T records in Orange, Green and Blue reproduce the whiteboard tallies exactly.

Red's round 3-5 columns are cut off in the whiteboard photo, so only the games legible on the poster are entered (5 of 15). Loose Meats vs Vandelay in round 1 was a circled win with no score, entered 1-0.
The 2023 round-robin schedule differs from the one setup() generates, so rounds and slots are imported explicitly.
Ranks were decided by head-to-head, not point differential, so Seed Overrides pin each pool's top 3 as actually seeded.
Bracket is winners only; scores recorded as 1-0. Bros Boor beat Don Cuzzi in the final.

Red's records come from the whiteboard tallies and the ranking notes (Loose Meats 4-1 87, Ghetto Ballers 3-1-1 85, The Seekers 3-2 89); they are entered in the Teams tab's Record column because the individual game scores are cut off in the photo. Totals check out: 14 wins, 14 losses, 1 tied game = 15 games.
ticker: WELCOME TO THE 2023 B.B.G.C. — Twenty-four teams, four groups of six, five rounds each. Three advance from every group.

GROUP PLAY · ORANGE — The Big LeBocce were the class of it: 4-1 and 99 points, the biggest haul in the tournament. Then a dead heat — Don Cuzzi and Loh Hang Balls both 3-2, Loh Hang with MORE points (84 to 78), and Don Cuzzi took the higher seed on the head-to-head. The Hawkeyes missed out at 2-3. THE BIG LeBOCCE, DON CUZZI and LOH HANG BALLS advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Another photo finish. Holy Rollers and Joanie Loves Bocce both finished 3-2, and again the team with fewer points took the group — Holy Rollers 71, Joanie 84. Hot Sauce came third out of a three-way 2-2-1 pile-up. HOLY ROLLERS, JOANIE LOVES BOCCE and HOT SAUCE advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — White Zin did not lose: 4-0-1, the only unbeaten record in the field. Sister Swap 3-1-1 behind them, and Bros Boor squeezed through third at 3-2 — which turned out to matter rather a lot. WHITE ZIN, SISTER SWAP and BROS BOOR advance.
GROUP PLAY · RED — Loose Meats took it at 4-1, Ghetto Ballers 3-1-1, The Seekers 3-2. A tight, scrappy group from start to finish. LOOSE MEATS, GHETTO BALLERS and THE SEEKERS advance.

ROUND ONE — Don Cuzzi ended The Seekers. Hot Sauce put out Ghetto Ballers. Loh Hang Balls ousted Joanie Loves Bocce. And Bros Boor — eleventh seed, third out of their own group — quietly took care of Sister Swap. Nobody was watching them yet.

QUARTERFINALS — And the top seed went down. DON CUZZI KNOCKED OUT WHITE ZIN, 4-0-1 in the group and unbeaten all day, in their very first game of the bracket. Hot Sauce ended Holy Rollers. The Big LeBocce held off Loh Hang Balls. And Bros Boor took down group champions Loose Meats.

SEMIFINALS — Don Cuzzi kept rolling, ending Hot Sauce. And Bros Boor struck again — this time burying The Big LeBocce and that tournament-best 99-point campaign. The eleven seed was one win from the trophy.

THE FINAL — Don Cuzzi: second out of Orange on a head-to-head tiebreak, then the unbeaten number one seed, then Hot Sauce. Bros Boor: ELEVENTH seed, third in their own group, and already the scalps of two group champions.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: BROS BOOR 🏆 — Eleventh seed. Third in their own group. And then they went out and beat Sister Swap, Loose Meats, The Big LeBocce and Don Cuzzi to lift the thing. One of the great runs in B.B.G.C. history. 2023 belongs to Bros Boor.
